brief:
Experts question whether Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's newly announced security doctrine and map of regional alliances reflect genuine strategic planning or serve primarily to bolster his political standing before upcoming elections, Al Jazeera English reported. The doctrine outlines Netanyahu's vision for Israel's regional posture and potential partnerships across the Middle East.

Analysts say the timing and presentation of the security framework align with Netanyahu's electoral calculations rather than representing a fundamental shift in Israeli defense policy. The announcement combines substantive security proposals with messaging designed to appeal to his political base.
dek: Experts say Netanyahu's security doctrine and map of regional alliances serve his political ambitions ahead of elections…
title: Netanyahu unveils regional security doctrine ahead of elections
